linearEnableDescription: Create and update Linear issues automatically
importDescription: Select which Linear issues to import into Forge as tasks.
realtimeDescription: Automatically import new tasks created in Linear
realtimeWarning: When enabled, new Linear issues will be automatically imported into Forge. Configure the team/project filters below to control which issues are imported.
githubEnableDescription: Sync issues from GitHub and create tasks automatically
issuesDescription: Access GitHub Issues from the sidebar to view, investigate, and create tasks from issues.
autoSyncDescription: Automatically fetch issues when the project loads
mainBranchDescription: The base branch for creating task worktrees. All new tasks will branch from here.
branchPreview: Task branches such as <branch>forge/task-name</branch> will be created from <base>{{name}}</base>.
projectConfigDescription: This GitHub repository is configured only for <project>{{name}}</project>. Each project can have its own GitHub repository.
